headline: "Just let my penny stock pass 1,000 won"… 46 companies at risk of designation as administrative issue stocks this week
summary: Dozens of stocks trading below 1,000 won face possible administrative issue designation under new penny stock delisting rules. Reviews start on the 12th, sequentially.
why: Administrative issue designation on the Korea Exchange warns of possible delisting and typically hurts liquidity and investor sentiment for affected small caps.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude
